title: Edmund and the Veil
premise: Sebastian Fairweather, a beast-speaker in the magic-outlawed city of Greyhollow, is betrayed when the crown's Veilwardens announce a purge of the gifted. Guided by a dying cartographer's map and a cynical fox who is more than he seems, Sebastian learns his gift is an inheritance from the vanished kingdom of Veilmark, whose last door still opens somewhere in the wilds. Hunted by the Veilwardens and by his own former patron, who wants the door's power for himself, Sebastian must choose between sealing magic away forever to save his friends or opening the door and restoring what his bloodline destroyed. In the end he opens the door, pours his gift through it, and lets Veilmark take the magic back — surviving, powerless, but finally honest.
about_author: Edmund Whitlock is the pen name of a former field cartographer who spent a decade mapping river deltas before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about borders, inheritance, and the lies families keep.
